evidence.quote: The master Q-former model is a 6-layer InstructBLIP-style [19] Q-Former that fuses the Stage 1 modality-specific tokens with a natural-language instruction, and produces 32 refined query tokens for the LLM.

the query tokens cross-attend with both the instruction tokens and self-attend with each other (mimicking the InstructBLIP concatenation trick), and cross-attend to the layer-normalised Stage 1 visual tokens every two transformer layers.

decisions.rationale: R3: the Master Q-former explicitly uses self-attention among query tokens and cross-attention to instruction and Stage 1 visual tokens.

decisions.rationale: R3: the frozen LLM is the receiving pretrained backbone, so it remains a learned-module boundary.
